exturaddon.docs.globals.extura: The Extura object that contains some random stuff. Only visible if it's enabled in the settings.
exturaddon.docs.globals.add_script:
(Exturaddon) Allows you to add, edit or remove scripts from your avatar.
Accepts 2 strings, if the second string is nil, the script is unloaded. If true is provided as a third argument, an error will be thrown if the script path doesn't already exist. Note this will NOT remove events
exturaddon.docs.globals.get_scripts: (Exturaddon) Returns a table of script names.
exturaddon.docs.globals.get_script: (Exturaddon) Returns the contents of a script or nil if the script doesn't exist.
exturaddon.config.use_secure_cloud.toolt: Whether to use a Secure Connection for the cloud
exturaddon.config.per_instance_config.to: If enabled, will pull from config folder, if disabled will pull from Figura folder
exturaddon.docs.world.get_spawn_point: (Exturaddon) Returns a vector with the coordinates of the world spawn
exturaddon.docs.world.isChunkLoaded: (Exturaddon) Returns whether a chunk is loaded at the given block position
exturaddon.docs.world.get_nearby_entitie: (Exturaddon) Returns entities near the given block position
exturaddon.docs.world.raycast_entity: (Exturaddon > linetraceEntity) Returns the entity and pos of a linetrace.
exturaddon.docs.world.get_all_entities: (Exturaddon) Returns all entities currently loaded on your client
exturaddon.docs.world.raycast_block: (Exturaddon > linetraceBlock) Returns the block, side, and pos of a linetrace
exturaddon.docs.itemstack.get_food_prope: (Exturaddon) Returns a table of an item's food properties. If the item is not edible, an empty table is returned
exturaddon.docs.world.linetraceBlock: (Exturaddon) Returns the block, side, and pos of a linetrace
exturaddon.docs.world.linetraceEntity: (Exturaddon) Returns the entity and pos of a linetrace
exturaddon.config.helper_errors.tooltip: Enables the game throwing errors for extra things to help preventing confusing errors later
exturaddon.config.get_blocks_limit.toolt: Toggles if scripts can bypass the 8 block limit of world.getBlocks
exturaddon.config.get_target_limit.toolt: Toggles if scripts can bypass the 20 block limit of entity.getTargetedBlock and entity.getTargetedEntity
exturaddon.config.use_global_scripts.too: Toggles if scripts are loaded from the `global_scripts` directory in your Figura folder. Note that they can override normal scripts if they have the same path/name
exturaddon.config.use_mc_host_resolver.t: Toggles if Minecraft's host resolver is used. Normal Figura uses this. Disabling this will allow ports and subdirs to be used
exturaddon.docs.avatar.set_nbt:
(Exturaddon) Set nbt of object at the path
* First argument is a table representing the path e.g `{'path','to','meow'}`
* Second argument is the object to replace with
* Third argument is the type, use this if you need a specific type
Valid types are: float, int, short, double, string, bool, boolean, bytearray, null, nil
exturaddon.docs.avatar.get_size_limit: (Exturaddon) Get the size limit of the avatar from the backend
exturaddon.docs.extura.allow_extura_chea:
(Exturaddon) Returns whether functions like host:setVelocity will work.
 Returns true if on a local server, permission level is above 2 or player has an objective named 'extura_can_cheat'
exturaddon.docs.extura.upload_avatar_to: (Exturaddon) Uploads your current avatar to FSB, Backend or both depending on supplied bools. First argument is for uploading to backend, second is for uploading to FSB. If both are false, it'll try to upload to FSB, then backend if unable to
exturaddon.docs.extura.upload_avatar: (Exturaddon) Uploads your current avatar to the backend and then reloads it
exturaddon.docs.extura.reload_avatar: (Exturaddon) Reloads the avatar of the entity UUID provided. If no UUID is provided then it'll reload your avatar
exturaddon.docs.extura.load_local_avatar: (Exturaddon) Loads the avatar from the specified path. If no path is provided, current avatar is unloaded.
exturaddon.docs.extura.set_player_moveme: (Exturaddon) Set if the player can move normally
exturaddon.docs.extura.get_player_moveme: (Exturaddon) Get if the player can move normally
exturaddon.docs.extura.start_riding:
(Exturaddon - Requires extura.allowExturaCheats() to be true) Force the player to ride a vehicle
* First argument is the entity to ride, if nil is provided then player will dismount instead
exturaddon.docs.extura.override_player_m:
(Exturaddon) Lock a specific input to a state,
* first argument is the input('up', 'down', 'left', 'right', 'jump', or 'shift')
* second argument is the state, true, false or nil to unlock
exturaddon.docs.extura.set_velocity: (Exturaddon - Requires extura.allowExturaCheats() to be true) Sets the player's velocity
exturaddon.docs.extura.set_position: (Exturaddon - Requires extura.allowExturaCheats() to be true) Sets the player's position
exturaddon.docs.extura.set_natural_force: (Exturaddon - Requires extura.allowExturaCheats() to be true) Sets if the player is effected by gravity and drag
exturaddon.docs.extura.set_gravity: (Exturaddon - Requires extura.allowExturaCheats() to be true) Sets if the player is effected by gravity
exturaddon.docs.extura.set_no_physics: (Exturaddon - Requires extura.allowExturaCheats() to be true) If false, no physics calculations will take place
exturaddon.docs.extura.set_bind_pressed:
(Exturaddon) Triggers a control bind. Allows running unbound binds, but may not work for modded binds. 
* First argument is the id for the bind. 
* Second argument may be a boolean for the state - many binds don't require this, and most that do will need it set at least every tick.
exturaddon.docs.extura.get_key_mappings:
(Exturaddon) Returns a table containing all available key mappings
Each keymapping is indexed by its id
exturaddon.docs.extura.set_shader_pack_n: (Exturaddon) Sets the currently selected shader pack, an empty value will select the internal shader
exturaddon.docs.extura.first_person_mode: (Exturaddon) Sets whether First Person Model is currently enabled
exturaddon.docs.extura.set_sensitivity: (Exturaddon) Sets your sensitivity through your sensitivity option
exturaddon.docs.extura.get_mod_version: (Exturaddon) Get the Version of a mod as a string. Returns an null if mod isn't loaded
exturaddon.docs.extura.get_mod_name: (Exturaddon) Gets the name of a mod as a string. Returns an empty string if the mod isn't loaded
exturaddon.docs.extura.get_uuid_from_pla: (Exturaddon) Returns the UUID of a player from their name
exturaddon.docs.extura.ping_rate_limit: (Exturaddon) Returns the amount of pings you can send in a second
exturaddon.docs.extura.ping_size_limit: (Exturaddon) Returns the max size of a ping
exturaddon.docs.extura.is_backend_connec: (Exturaddon) Returns true if using backend is connected. Will NOT be effected by FSB
exturaddon.docs.extura.get_current_backe:
(Exturaddon) Returns the current IP being used for the backend, the ip to the server if using FSB or an empty string if not connected at all.
* if true, ignores FSB
exturaddon.docs.extura.is_integrated_ser: (Exturaddon) Returns if the client is on it's integrated server
exturaddon.docs.extura.get_bossbars:
Returns a table of bossbars.
Indexed by the bar's UUID, and contains the bossbar's name (JSON formatted), (lerped) progress, color, style, and whether the bar causes fog, darkens the screen, and causes music
exturaddon.docs.extura.first_person_mode: (Exturaddon) Gets whether First Person Model is currently enabled
(Exturaddon) Gets whether First Person Model is currently rendering - only useful in a RENDER event
exturaddon.docs.extura.regex_find: (Exturaddon) Checks a string against a (Java flavor) Regular Expression and returns true if any matches are found
exturaddon.docs.extura.regex_match: (Exturaddon) Matches a string against a (Java flavor) Regular Expression and returns all matches
exturaddon.docs.extura.regex_replace: (Exturaddon) Matches a string against a (Java flavor) Regular Expression and replaces all matches with a specified string
exturaddon.docs.player.get_destroy_speed: (Exturaddon) Returns the player's destroy speed for a specific block
exturaddon.docs.player.has_correct_tool_: (Exturaddon) Returns if the player's tool can get drops from a specific block
exturaddon.docs.player.can_harm_player: (Exturaddon) Returns if the player can be harmed by the passed in player
exturaddon.docs.player.is_using_spy_glas: (Exturaddon) Returns if the player is using a spy glass
exturaddon.docs.player.get_projectile: (Exturaddon) Returns the player's current projectile for the passed in item
exturaddon.docs.player.get_latency: (Exturaddon) Returns the player's latency. Returns -1 if unable to get latency
exturaddon.docs.player.get_tablist_displ: (Exturaddon) Returns the player's display name on the tab list
exturaddon.docs.player.get_nameplate:
(Exturaddon) Returns the player's nameplate text if they have one, otherwise returns null.
 First argument should be the nameplate type(LIST, CHAT, ENTITY)
exturaddon.docs.living_entity.get_namepl:
(Exturaddon) Returns the entity's nameplate text if they have one, otherwise returns null.
 First argument should be the nameplate type(LIST, CHAT, ENTITY)
exturaddon.docs.entity.get_supporting_bl: (Exturaddon) Returns the position of the block supporting the entity
exturaddon.permissions.value.printing.to: Allows this avatar to print to chat if Log Others is enabled
exturaddon.config.use_cache.tooltip:
Prevents Extura from caching avatars.
* This enforces you'll always have the latest avatar of someone.
* This might cause issues since Extura is not entirely designed to be used without caching
exturaddon.docs.extura.get_figura_settin: Grabs a Figura setting and returns the value of it
exturaddon.docs.extura.get_minecraft_set: Grabs all Minecraft settings(Currently does not properly map to human readable names!)
exturaddon.docs.extura.async_lua_functio: Runs specified lua function in a thread. NOTE: VERY UNSTABLE!
exturaddon.docs.extura.httpGet: Makes an http request to a url

exturaddon.docs.events.upload:
(Exturaddon) Runs before your avatar is uploaded
Return true to cancel upload
exturaddon.docs.events.pre_render:
Runs at the HEAD of Minecraft's render function.
Argument 1 is a number between 0 to 1 for the delta between last tick and the next tick
Argument 2 is a string with the name of the source of this render event (See /figura docs enums render_modes)
exturaddon.docs.events.file_drop:
(Exturaddon) Runs whenever a file is dropped into the game window.
Argument 1 is a table of all dropped in files as input streams. These streams are closed after the event is finished.
Return true to prevent the game from attempting to do anything with the dropped files
